chunks: O Allah, I have become weary of them and they have become weary of me,
I have grown sick of them and they have grown sick of me. So replace them with better ones for me, and replace me with worse ones for them,
O Allah, melt their hearts as salt melts in water,
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication of Imam Ali regarding his weariness with his enemies?
ai.summary: Recorded in Nahj al-Balagha during the period when Imam Ali’s forces were strained by Muawiya’s political maneuvering, this dua reflects the psychological toll of prolonged conflict and the desire for divine intervention to soften hardened hearts. The metaphor of salt dissolving in water illustrates the scholar’s view of gradual spiritual erosion of stubbornness, emphasizing patience (sabr) and reliance on Allah’s power to transform enmity into peace.

en.sayed-ali-raza: O my Allāh they are disgusted of me and I am disgusted of them. They are weary of me and I am weary of them.
Change them for me with better ones and change me for them with worse one.
O my Allāh melt their hearts as salt melts in water.
